Refunds usually take 5 to 10 working days to appear. If it’s been longer, check your transaction list for a separate incoming entry. If you still don’t see it after 10 working days, ask the merchant for proof of the refund, including the date, amount and reference.

If you want to revert a transaction, you can’t do it manually. A card payment is only reversed automatically if the merchant cancels it or doesn’t collect the money in time. A top‑up is reversed automatically if it was cancelled after it first appeared. In either case the money is returned to your balance or to the original source.
